cameras._comment: Real camera positions (confirmed by product owner). docs/readme.md has WRONG info!

camera_intrinsics._comment: Nominal focal length ~22000px derived from known helmet size + camera distances. Needs real calibration!

model_geometry._comment: Helmet coordinate system: center at 0,0; bottom edge near Z=0; dome goes up to Z~170mm
model_geometry._comment2: Triangles with Z > cut_zone_min_z_mm are used for silhouette fitting (excludes raw edge)

ls_robot._comment: LS file uses UF:2 UT:2 robot coordinate system. UF2 matrix needed for correct mapping!

fitting._comment: translation_penalty > 0 prevents tilt-to-shift degeneracy (rx underestimation bug)
fitting._comment2: render_scale: fraction of full resolution for silhouette render (speed vs accuracy)
